name: Ringed by Ice and Death
description: a creature is surrounded by an aura of cold, necrotic magic. At the start of the creature’s turn, enemies within 5 feet take 2 (1d4) cold damage plus 2 (1d4) necrotic damage. If two or more enemies take damage from the aura on a single turn, the creature’s black ice spray recharges immediately.
